leie-excerpt.csv.contents: EXCERPT of the complete LEIE database file UPDATED.csv: 23 lines, each byte verbatim from the coordinator's captures on issue #180. The header row and the first 10 data rows (entities) and 10 rows with LASTNAME SMITH are from Capture B (comment 6380711049); the two rows with a non-zero WAIVERDATE (MIRANDA and WAHIB) are from the byte verbatim correction (comment 6380713028), which supersedes the retyped versions in Capture B. Order here: the header, the first 10 data rows of the file, then the selected rows by LASTNAME. Lines end in LF here; the captures do not state the complete file's line terminator.
